data.one_liner: Country and currency picker widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides dropdown, dialog, and Cupertino pickers for selecting countries and currencies, including flags and phone codes.
use_when: You need a ready‑made country picker UI
You want to display country flags and phone codes
You need a currency picker with flags
avoid_when: You need custom picker logic not covered by the provided widgets
You require advanced filtering or search customization beyond the built‑in options
strengths: Easy to integrate, single widget API
Includes flag images and phone/currency codes
weaknesses: No advanced filtering or search customization
Limited to the provided data set
No support for custom data sources
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
